page.overview:
Who is Ahiru?

Ahiru is the deputy commander of the East Army in the Revolutionary Army and the assistant of Belo Betty.

Ahiru is a woman with pale skin, prominent lips and long hair. Her left arm is a mechanical prosthesis. She wears a blouse with an only right long sleeve, a brown glove and a red tie; in her initial appearance, she also wore a green jacket. She has a pair of goggles on her head.

In her initial appearance, her prosthesis was light and dark green in the anime and gray in the colored manga and her hair was brown; in the anime's later depictions, it is pink while her hair color is black. She was also initially depicted with tanned skin and a black blouse, instead of the white blouse used in the anime's later depictions of her.

As a member of the Revolutionary Army, Ahiru has no qualms with challenging the World Government, especially with her status as an officer.
